title: Publish release 2.41.1 through the sanctioned script
action: Run `scripts/release.sh 2.41.1` with BEE_DISPATCH_ID set to an authorized deployment dispatch. The script bumps both plugin manifests, runs the regen chain (render-skill-trees, onboard --apply, release-manifest --write), runs the declared test suite before tagging, makes the release commit, tags v2.41.1, pushes main and the tag, waits for the release-binaries workflow and verifies the published assets. Never walk those steps by hand. Re-running at a version already committed is idempotent — it resumes the tail. The regen obligation on .claude-plugin/plugin.json is discharged INSIDE the script's own regen chain, which is why the release manifest rides this cell's files.

truths: tag v2.41.1 exists locally and on the remote
the GitHub release for v2.41.1 carries the binaries and SHA256SUMS
the script printed its final OK line
key_links: the pushed tag is what triggers release-binaries.yml
prohibitions: Do not hand-walk bump, tag or push
Do not skip the test gate

deviations: the first deployment dispatch was a cell dispatch and the second was refused on a moved main commit; both refused before any mutation
trace.verification_evidence: the script ran the full declared suite before tagging; git ls-remote shows v2.41.1 at ebfc0422, gh run 35217169787 success, gh release lists linux, windows and SHA256SUMS

mistakes.wrong: dispatched the deploy as --kind cell and committed a cell file after preparing the permit
mistakes.better: prepare with --stage deployment --role deploy only after main is clean and committed

trace.commit_pending: scripts/release.sh writes the release commit ebfc04220 itself, without a cell trailer
trace.inline_reason: the release ran in a deployment-stage dispatch (herding job), not a cell dispatch, as release.sh requires
